patches.title: Avoid Closed Container Examination
patches.principle: Never examine a closed drawer or cabinet; open it first to see its contents.
patches.when_to_apply: When you encounter a closed container and want to know what is inside.

patches.title: Take Matching Category Objects
patches.principle: If the task specifies a generic type (e.g., 'some box'), accept any object of that category.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target description is vague and you see a similar object.

patches.title: Direct Placement After Clean
patches.principle: After cleaning the object, go straight to the destination and place it without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: When you are holding a cleaned object and the destination is known.
